conventions.convention: The integral circle algebra is Z[X]/(X²), with deg(1)=1 and deg(X)=−1. Resolution 0 is the source-chart A-smoothing, resolution 1 is the B-smoothing; the edge at crossing j has sign (−1) raised to the sum of preceding state coordinates. Circle-factor permutations carry no Koszul signs.
The normalized state degrees are i=|v|−n₋ and j=|v|+n₊−2n₋+sum of label degrees; crossing signs use det(v_over,v_under) in the oriented projection plane.

Integral reduced cohomology is defined for based knots by quotienting C(D) by im(X_p), retaining the based-circle label 1 and lowering its quantum grading by one. The equivalent distinguished interval module is Z with X acting by zero.
Shifts lower displayed degrees: C[s]^i=C^(i+s) and M{s}_j=M_(j+s). Thus normalization is the raw cube shifted by [n₋]{2n₋−n₊}.
Euler characteristics use integral ranks, q=−A⁻² and t=q²=A⁻⁴. The unreduced unknot factor is q+q⁻¹; the reduced factor is 1. The comparison with the library Jones polynomial assumes full AC.

load_bearing.statement: Defines the normalized integral signed resolution cube using Z[X]/(X²), multiplication and comultiplication, with state degrees i=|v|−n₋ and j=|v|+n₊−2n₋+sum of circle-label degrees.

The integral signed Khovanov cubes have local graded cancellation models that are chain homotopy equivalences over every fixed exterior resolution, commute with exterior saddle differentials, and commute with multiplication by X at every marked point outside the local disk; consequently they descend to the reduced quotient.

Finite regular oriented link diagrams related by planar isotopy or one oriented Reidemeister move have bigraded chain homotopy equivalent normalized integral complexes. For based knot diagrams with move disk disjoint from the basepoint, the equivalence descends to the reduced quotient complexes.

Assuming countable choice, cutting any two marked finite regular diagrams of the same oriented smooth knot produces proper arcs realizable in one standard smooth three-ball that are smoothly isotopic relative to identified endpoints and collars; their diagrams admit a finite relative Reidemeister movie. This includes moving only the mark.
For the finite ordered resolution cube with the stated Frobenius edge maps and signs, the sum d of all edge maps satisfies d²=0.

For a nonempty finite regular oriented link diagram, under q=−A⁻² the unreduced integral-rank Euler characteristic is (q+q⁻¹)f_D(A); for a based knot diagram the reduced integral-rank Euler characteristic is f_D(A).

Compact-source ambient extension, including a moving three-ball and isotopies without stationary endpoints.
Finite-jet perturbations, singularity codimensions, deleted-diagonal accumulation control, and regular-interval planar isotopies.
Identification of cusps, quadratic tangencies, and transverse triple events with oriented R1, R2, and R3.
Choosing perturbation parameters outside the null sets of nontransverse slices under ACω.
Dimensions and tangent spaces of transverse configuration and jet loci.
Allowed local moves, orientations, and strict height orders.
Ambient planar isotopies preserving the decorated oriented diagram.
Degree-increasing differential and the chain/cochain reindexing convention.
The homotopy identity and its cochain reindexing.
Mutually inverse chain maps up to homotopy and induced cohomology isomorphisms.
The identity-cone model underlying local contractible summands.
Finite move sequences between diagrams representing the same oriented link under ACω.
Full-AC hypothesis of the library Jones comparison.
Supplying ACω from full AC in the Euler-characteristic theorem.
The curled diagrams in the normalization counterexample represent the same oriented unknot.

seams_checked.note: Checked the source-chart A/B pairings, determinant crossing signs, loop value, writhe correction, and full-AC bracket/Jones comparison. The substitution q=−A⁻² is maintained.

The Lee definition retains the signed cube and normalized degrees. Its invariance proof explicitly rechecks the circle-coordinate and neck-cutting identities for X²=1 before reusing the cancellation models.

The unit, counit, multiplication, comultiplication, and link-level groups match their suppliers. Movie maps use separately specified formal Reidemeister constructions; functoriality is not inferred from diagram invariance alone.

The instanton spectral-sequence and detection items use the integral reduced quotient, its unknot generator in degree (0,0), and ACω based-diagram invariance at their stated interfaces; the spectral-sequence page forgets the bigrading.

The F2 based-link definition preserves the quotient and quantum shift. Component independence and based-link move invariance are supplied separately, rather than attributed to the integral knot-only reduced-invariance theorem.
